intervals.label: collaboration: measurement runs at the ILL (2008/2009, 2014/2015, 2019/2020)
intervals.locator: TUM PERKEO III page, last paragraph
intervals.note: Runs: beta asymmetry A 2008/2009; proton asymmetry C 2014 and 2015; beta spectrum 2019 and 2020 ("Analysis of the data is ongoing"). No later run was found, so the interval is left open; whether the spectrometer is still in use at the ILL is not stated.
intervals.quote: In 2019 and 2020 we successfully performed a measurement of the beta spectrum with the aim to strongly improve the limits on the Fierz interfernce term b using an unpolarised, pulsed neutron beam.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who run the PERKEO III experiment.
